jobs.title: Entrepreneur in Residence
jobs.description:
**We’re hiring: Entrepreneur in Residence — New Category | SOLARA**

We’re looking for someone to build a new consumer durables category from
**0 to 1**
.

This is a hands-on business ownership role: identify the opportunity, develop the products, bring them to market, and build the operations needed to deliver a great customer experience.

You’ll work directly with the founders and own the category’s growth, profitability, and execution.

**What you’ll own**

* **Category strategy:**
  Understand customers, competition, pricing, and market gaps. Define the product range and business plan.
* **Product and manufacturing:**
  Work with manufacturers and suppliers on specifications, sourcing, costing, quality, compliance, and launch timelines.
* **Go-to-market:**
  Coordinate positioning, content, marketing, channel launches, and sales execution.
* **Service operations:**
  Build installation, after-sales service, warranty, spare-parts availability, and escalation processes.
* **Category P&L:**
  Own revenue, margins, inventory, working capital, and customer experience.
* **Team building:**
  Identify the people and partners needed, establish clear responsibilities, and build repeatable processes as the category grows.

**Who we’re looking for**

* You’ve helped build a product, category, or business from scratch—and can clearly explain what you personally owned.
* You combine commercial judgment with operational discipline. You’re comfortable discussing manufacturing costs, marketing performance, and service issues.
* You can turn an ambiguous goal into a practical plan and drive it through to completion.
* You’re willing to visit suppliers, speak to customers, troubleshoot launch problems, and get into the details.
* Experience in consumer durables, appliances, hardware, or another product business with manufacturing and after-sales complexity would be valuable.

You could be a former founder, an early-stage startup operator, or a category/product leader ready for broader ownership.

**What you’ve built matters more than your title.**

**What success looks like**

A differentiated product range launched with dependable manufacturing, a clear route to customers, functioning service operations, and a credible path to profitable growth.

Know someone who would thrive in this role? Please share this with them.

* #Hiring #EntrepreneurInResidence #CategoryManagement #ConsumerDurables #SOLARA

Let's do this. Let's change the world!
  
  
In this vital role, the L5 Product Owner / Scrum Master will serve as the primary Product Owner and Agile delivery lead for the India-based AIN team supporting the SAGE program. The role combines hands-on backlog ownership and requirement clarification with Scrum Master facilitation, delivery leadership, and Agile coaching to enable clear priorities, predictable execution, and high-quality outcomes.
  
  
Working across business, product, engineering, architecture, data science, QA, and leadership, the role will translate business and technical priorities into actionable work, maintain stakeholder alignment, remove impediments, coordinate dependencies, and strengthen the team's ways of working.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Overview**
**Overview**
**Product Owner**
**BASIC SUMMARY:**
We are seeking a detail-oriented and execution-focused Product Owner to support the delivery of features and enhancements within our healthcare claims administration platform. This role is responsible for translating business and stakeholder needs into clear, actionable user stories and working closely with engineering teams to ensure timely, high-quality delivery. The ideal candidate brings healthcare domain knowledge, understands Agile processes, and is comfortable using AI-enabled tools to support requirements definition and backlog management.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**Backlog Ownership & Agile Execution**

* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring stories are well-defined, prioritized, and aligned with sprint goals
* Write epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that are clear, testable, and customer-centric
* Conduct regular backlog grooming and sprint planning in collaboration with the Scrum team
* Manage daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives as an active team member
* Ensure user stories meet the definition of ready and done before development and release

**Requirements Gathering & User Story Development**

* Collaborate with stakeholders, subject matter experts, and internal teams to gather and refine product requirements
* Use AI tools (where applicable) to support the creation of epics, themes, and user stories
* Conduct gap analysis and validation of requirements to ensure completeness and feasibility
* Support refinement of use cases, workflows, and functional documentation

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for development teams during sprint execution
* Partner with UX/UI designers to ensure user stories are aligned with design principles and usability goals
* Support QA teams by clarifying acceptance criteria and reviewing test cases as needed
* Coordinate with other Product Owners to manage interdependencies between features

**Customer & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Participate in stakeholder meetings to capture feature requests, enhancement ideas, and feedback
* Communicate updates to internal stakeholders on backlog priorities, delivery timelines, and sprint progress
* Help ensure features delivered meet customer needs and stakeholder expectations

**Healthcare Domain Support**

* Apply working knowledge of healthcare claims workflows, billing terminology, and reimbursement processes
* Support compliance with healthcare regulations (HIPAA, HITECH) in collaboration with internal teams
* Assist in translating complex healthcare requirements into understandable product features

**Minimum Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, or a related field
* 2+ years of product management experience; healthcare technology or claims administration preferred
* 2+ years of experience working with AI tools for product development, requirements engineering, or business analysis preferred
* Familiarity with Agile software development and Scrum methodology
* Proficiency with Jira (or similar Agile tools) for backlog management
* AI-Enabled Product Management
* Demonstrated experience incorporating AI tools into day-to-day product management activities
* Ability to establish and maintain reusable prompts, instructions, and workflows that improve requirements quality and team productivity
* Ability to validate, challenge, and refine AI-generated artifacts to ensure business, technical, regulatory, and operational accuracy
* Basic understanding of software development processes and technical constraints
* Familiarity with collaboration tools (e.g., Confluence, Miro, Figma)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for conveying requirements and feedback
* High attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
* Comfortable working with cross-functional teams and resolving blockers quickly
* Experience working in healthcare technology, payer operations, care management, utilization management, claims administration, or related healthcare domain

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification
* Understanding of healthcare data standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR, X12 EDI)
* Experience with Utilization Management, Prior Authorization, Care Management, Clinical Review, or related payer operations workflows
* Familiarity with medical necessity determination processes
* Familiarity with InterQual, MCG, or payer-specific clinical guidelines
* Understanding of healthcare regulatory requirements including CMS, NCQA, URAC, HIPAA, and state-specific UM regulations
* Experience collaborating with UM nurses, Medical Directors, physician reviewers, and clinical operations teams
* Knowledge of Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and Dual Eligible healthcare programs
* Familiarity with authorization intake, clinical review, peer review, and determination workflows
* Experience with workflow engines, rules engines, or clinical decision support systems

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Chief Product Officer — Enterprise AI Products**

**Role Overview**

is seeking a Chief Product Officer (CPO) to own the strategy, innovation, market relevance, and product

credibility of its enterprise AI product portfolio. The CPO defines what the company builds, why it matters to customers,

how it is differentiated, and how product investment translates into adoption, intellectual property, and long-term

enterprise value.

This is a hands-on product leadership role for an AI product company — not a services delivery role. The CPO is

expected to have personally built and commercialized enterprise technology or AI products before, and to bring that

credibility directly into the company's product decisions, market positioning, and investor narrative.

The CPO works closely with the CEO and leadership team on portfolio priorities, and partners with a separate Chief

Revenue Officer (CRO) function on go-to-market execution. The CPO equips Sales and Business Development with

product truth, evidence, and narrative — but does not own a sales quota or revenue target. Revenue accountability sits

with the CRO organization.

*Note: This role is deliberately scoped without quota or revenue ownership. Product credibility and commercial enablement*

*are the mandate; carrying a number belongs to the CRO role, hired separately.*

**Role Allocation & Primary Outcomes**

**A. Product Strategy, Innovation & Portfolio Leadership — 50%**

• Own the enterprise AI product vision, portfolio strategy, product roadmap, and investment priorities in alignment

with company strategy and target markets.

• Define clear product theses: which enterprise problems Cortexa will solve, for whom, why the problems matter,

and where the company can establish sustainable differentiation.

• Continuously assess developments in GenAI, agentic AI, LLMs/SLMs, domain models, RAG, enterprise AI

platforms, AI governance, evaluation, observability, and orchestration; determine their relevance to the portfolio.

• Maintain a structured view of competitors, substitutes, cloud/platform capabilities, customer build-vs-buy

decisions, and market white spaces; translate these insights into roadmap choices.

• Establish a continuous product-discovery process using customer interviews, market evidence, competitive

intelligence, and experiments — rather than feature development in isolation.

• Sponsor rapid prototypes, technical spikes, and proofs of concept to test product hypotheses quickly; define

explicit go, pivot, partner, or stop criteria before larger investments.

• Drive product architecture and capability principles with Principal Architects/Engineering leadership to keep the

portfolio scalable, reusable, and technically differentiated.

• Build and govern an IP pipeline: identify patentable ideas, sponsor invention disclosures, support patent

development, and connect the IP portfolio to product differentiation and investor narrative.

• Establish product metrics covering adoption, usage, customer value, quality, time-to-value, and differentiation;

use evidence to guide roadmap decisions.

• Own product lifecycle decisions, including incubation, launch, scale, repositioning, partnership, consolidation,

and retirement.

**B. Market Insight & Commercial Enablement — 30%**

• Act as the executive bridge between Product and the market — maintaining direct engagement with customers,

prospects, partners, analysts, and industry stakeholders to understand evolving enterprise AI requirements.

• Partner closely with the CRO, Business Development, Sales, and Marketing to convert market signals, pipeline

patterns, objections, and competitive wins/losses into actionable product strategy.• Participate in strategic customer discovery and executive conversations to understand business priorities, AI

maturity, buying criteria, and expected value — in support of Sales-led opportunities, not as the deal owner.

• Shape product positioning, packaging, solution propositions, target customer profiles, and differentiated sales

narratives for each product or product family.

• Assess strategic opportunities for product fit, roadmap implications, customization risk, and technical feasibility,

at the CRO's or Sales leadership's request.

• Support priority pre-sales engagements as a product expert — customer workshops, product demonstrations,

technical/product Q&A, and proof-of-value definition — without personally owning deal outcomes or quota.

• Ensure Sales and Business Development have strong product assets: solution briefs, competitive battlecards,

demos, architecture narratives, FAQs, and ROI/value narratives.

• Work with Marketing to develop technically credible product marketing, thought leadership, white papers, and

research-led content.

• Represent Cortexa externally through conferences, customer forums, and industry publications to build market

and investor credibility around the product.

• Identify strategic partnerships, OEM opportunities, and ecosystem integrations that can accelerate product reach.

• Create a closed feedback loop from CRO/pipeline insight to roadmap, and from roadmap/releases back to Sales

and Marketing.

**C. Product Execution & Delivery Governance — 20%**

• Translate portfolio strategy into clear product priorities, roadmaps, and release objectives for Product,

AI/Research, Engineering, and Delivery teams.

• Establish product governance across discovery, prototype, MVP, productization, launch, and scale — while

avoiding unnecessary process overhead.

• Review major architecture and technology decisions with technical leadership for alignment with product

strategy, scalability, security, and enterprise readiness.

• Ensure customer-specific work does not unnecessarily fragment the core product; identify what should become

reusable product capability versus one-off configuration.

• Guide strategic PoCs and early customer implementations to validate product-market…

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
  
  
Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
  
  
We are looking for an exceptionally talented resource to join one of our cross-functional product teams for an individual contributor role. The Product Management group partners with technology teams across the product lifecycle to specify, develop, and deliver the firm's infrastructure and middle- and back-office applications. This position offers the opportunity to define and design the next generation of products in the Investor Accounting and Transfer Agency domain, which is used by some of the most sophisticated hedge funds in the world, and to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Contribute to the product vision for Investor Allocation modules and carry features from concept to creation.
* Distill the vision into documents such as product roadmap and feature specifications via deep dives into the domain, gathering requirements, and solutioning.
* Work closely with engineers and architects to translate the product specification to design, and then to the product itself.
* Articulate business cases, ROI analyses, budgets, and timelines; communicate progress and priorities to all stakeholders, including clients.
* Conduct market research and competitive landscape analysis to stay ahead of industry trends.
* Collaborate with Product Managers across product groups on cross-cutting initiatives.

**What You'll Need**

* 8–12 years of experience in Investor Allocation, including 2+ years in a product management role.
* Deep subject matter expertise in Investor Allocation for hedge funds and institutional asset managers.
* Proven knowledge of complex fund structures (master-feeder, side pockets, hybrid vehicles), multi-currency frameworks, and unitization.
* Strong understanding of diverse fee models — management fees, performance fees, hurdle rates, high-water marks, and tiered fee structures.
* Strong critical thinking and the ability to articulate standpoints/ideas and influence stakeholders.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* Outstanding academic background and a passion for working in a high-tech software development environment.

Arcesium's Personal Data Privacy Notice for Candidates is linked here.

Emails from genuine Arcesium recruiters who are employees of the company will always come from the @arcesium.com domain. If something seems off or you're contacted by an unexpected third party, please reach out to us at careers@arcesium.com (US/UK), careers-india@arcesium.com (India) or careers-europe@arcesium.com (Portugal/Sweden).

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About TruKKer and the Role**

TruKKer is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer who owns the full journey from a business problem to a solution people actually use, building with Claude Code on top of our existing systems.

TruKKer is a technology-driven road freight and logistics company. Our business teams run on fast-moving, process-heavy workflows, and many of their pain points are best solved by small, well-targeted software rather than long project cycles.

The Forward Deployed Engineer sits inside that gap: one person, embedded with the business, who can understand a problem, decide what to build, build it, prove it works, roll it out and keep it useful. There are no hand-offs between a business analyst, a product manager, a developer and a tester.

**The Forward Deployed Engineer is all of them for the solutions they own.**

  

If you prefer working from requirements someone else has already written, this is not the role. If you would rather spend a morning with an operations team, find where hours are leaking every week, and have something working in front of them soon after, read on.

  

**Role Summary**

The Forward Deployed Engineer is the single owner of a solutions entire lifecycle. You start by understanding what the business team is struggling with, and you finish only when the team is using the solution and getting value from it.

  

**In practice you will:**

* Spend time with business teams to find and define real problems, not just take requests.
* Research the product options and gather requirements from the right stakeholders.
* Build the solution end to end using Claude Code, either as an enhancement to an existing system or a new build from scratch.
* Test it yourself, end to end, before anyone else sees it.
* Train the business team, launch the solution and stay on as its owner.
* Track adoption, and when usage is low, find out why and fix it.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

The work runs in seven stages. You own every one of them.

**1. Discover and understand business challenges**

* Work closely with business teams to learn how they operate day to day and where time, money or accuracy is being lost.
* Identify and prioritise the problems worth solving, using impact, effort and urgency.
* Define each problem clearly, with a measurable outcome, before any solution is proposed.

**2. Research and define the solution**

* Research the product space: how similar problems are solved elsewhere, and whether to enhance an existing system or build something new.
* Gather and document requirements from the relevant stakeholders (business users, managers, data owners, engineering).
* Propose a solution with scope, trade-offs and success criteria, and get alignment before building.

**3. Build end to end with Claude Code**

* Design and develop the solution using Claude Code, either as an enhancement within TruKKer’s existing systems or as a new build from scratch.
* Handle the full stack of the solution: data, logic, integrations, interface and deployment.
* Make sound decisions on architecture, security, access control and maintainability, and review AI-generated code with care.
* Keep documentation current so others can understand and support what you have built.

**4. Test it yourself**

* Own end-to-end testing: functional, integration, edge cases, data accuracy and user-flow checks.

jobs.description:
**About TruKKer and the Role**

TruKKer is hiring a Business Solutions Engineer who owns the full journey from a business problem to a solution people actually use, building with Claude Code on top of our existing systems.

TruKKer is a technology-driven road freight and logistics company. Our business teams run on fast-moving, process-heavy workflows, and many of their pain points are best solved by small, well-targeted software rather than long project cycles.

The Business Solutions Engineer sits inside that gap: one person, embedded with the business, who can understand a problem, decide what to build, build it, prove it works, roll it out and keep it useful. There are no hand-offs between a business analyst, a product manager, a developer and a tester.

  

**The Business Solutions Engineer is all of them for the solutions they own.**

  

If you prefer working from requirements someone else has already

written, this is not the role. If you would rather spend a morning with an operations team, find where hours are leaking every week, and have something working in front of them soon after, read on.

  

**Role Summary**

The Business Solutions Engineer is the single owner of a solutions entire lifecycle. You start by understanding what the business team is struggling with, and you finish only when the team is using the solution and getting value from it.

  

**In practice you will:**

* Spend time with business teams to find and define real problems, not just take requests.
* Research the product options and gather requirements from the right stakeholders.
* Build the solution end to end using Claude Code, either as an enhancement to an existing system or a new build from scratch.
* Test it yourself, end to end, before anyone else sees it.
* Train the business team, launch the solution and stay on as its owner.
* Track adoption, and when usage is low, find out why and fix it.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Keep documentation current so others can understand and support what you have built.

**4. Test it yourself**

* Own end-to-end testing: functional, integration, edge cases, data accuracy and user-flow checks.
* Validate with realistic business data and scenarios, and fix issues before release.

* Prepare simple guides or demos so users can adopt the solution without hand-holding.
* Manage the rollout and go-live, including the first weeks of hypercare.

* Be the point of contact for business queries, issues and enhancement requests on your solutions.
* Triage and resolve issues quickly, and scope, build and ship enhancements as needs evolve.

* If usage is low, sit down with the business to find the real reason (workflow fit, trust, training, missing features, process change).
* Provide and deliver the fix, whether that is a product change, more training or a process adjustment, until the solution is part of how the team works.

Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. On occasion we may request for you to commute to our nearest office for in person engagement activities such as team meetings, training and culture events. To ensure the safety of our colleagues and communities, we require employees who come together in-person to be fully vaccinated. We’re proud to offer you choice and flexibility.

* Document and maintain functional business requirements, process flows and business use cases

jobs.description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Basel III Business Analyst – Manager/Senior**
**Description**
EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls.
  
  
Within EY’s Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
  
  
Within FSRM, the CSTC team assists across end-to-end aspects of Capital management, BASEL, credit risk and Stress testing related activities:
  
  

* Key role involves producing critical deliverables to the senior management and regulators including EMEIA, US and APAC entities’ credit risk review, capital projections, Basel 4, Basel 3 endgame, capital aspects of Recovery & Resolution planning (RRP), stress testing and having oversight of various regulatory requirements.
* Consulting and solutions delivery such as impact assessments, defining the target operating model, and integrated risk and finance reporting framework
* Quality assurance such as assessment of controls of the Banking industry and similar business lines covering regulatory reporting involving Basel/CRR/RRP regulations
* Early identification and accurate analysis of prudential developments and influence on changes to the capital framework.
* Regulatory capital impact assessment in legal entity simplification initiatives, business re-organizations, new business initiatives and external commitments to regulators

Clients include large domestic and global financial institutions, broker-dealers, foreign banking organizations, asset management firms with significant capital markets activities. Project teams frequently work with the senior management of these firms, including CFOs and CROs.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The role is for a Basel III Business Analyst supporting the Basel III Proposal Roadmap implementation. The engagement focuses on restarting Basel III Proposal implementation program, adopting the Expanded Risk-Based Approach (ERBA), accelerating Single Counterparty Credit Limits (SCCL) gross exposure measurements, and onboarding incremental Basel III data requirements into the Unified Consumption Layer (UCL) Data Factory. The candidate will support exposure-pod based execution across credit risk, securitization, credit risk mitigation, derivatives / SA-CCR, operational risk, and related regulatory capital workstreams. The role requires strong business analysis, regulatory capital, data sourcing, data profiling, source-to-target mapping, calculation logic documentation, Axiom input mapping, controls design, testing, governance, and stakeholder management capabilities. The candidate will work closely with Risk, Finance, Technology, Data, Operations, and business stakeholders to produce implementation-ready requirements, support interim ERBA calculator development, and enable transparent program execution through high-quality documentation, testing, and governance routines.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support detailed implementation planning, governance, project management, status reporting, RAID / action trackers, decision logs, and senior stakeholder updates for the B3P Roadmap.
* Refresh the Basel III Proposal / ERBA gap assessment and identify new, modified, or enhanced data elements required for rule interpretation, regulatory capital calculations, and downstream reporting.
* Perform data profiling and fit-for-use analysis across existing UCL data elements and source-system data, including review of missing values, syntax consistency, data completeness, appropriateness for regulatory requirements, and data quality issues.
* Document data sourcing, transformation, derivation, and calculation logic requirements for ERBA exposure types including residential mortgage / MSR, CRE, retail, off-balance sheet, corporates, banks, securitization, credit risk mitigation, collateral haircut approach, derivatives / SA-CCR, and operational risk.
* Develop source-to-target mappings, business data dictionaries, data lineage, and transformation specifications to support onboarding of incremental Basel III data requirements into the UCL Data Factory.
* Support UCL Data Factory activities, including data movement logic, UCL data model design, legacy consumption views, UCL ADRS unification, semantic layer configuration inputs, and source-to-target reconciliation / data validation activities.
* Map data elements to Axiom-required calculation inputs and document the business rules, derivations, assumptions, controls, and evidence required to support regulatory capital processing.
* Assist in the design, build, and testing…

jobs.title: Business Analyst II, ROC WFM (Workforce Management)
jobs.description:
**Description**
As a WFM Long-Term Planning Analyst, you will create efficient, implementable headcount plans. You will own variable cost budgeting for your scope to meet financial goals and enable scaling, identifying the optimal levels of operations to meet volume demand. You will work closely with Program, Business Operations, Analytics, and Finance to ensure the right headcount is available to meet business needs at an hourly granularity. You will identify risks and provide mitigation plans, and proactively plan for high-demand peaks to ensure operational readiness.
  
  
You must be highly analytical, able to work effectively in a matrix organization, and have the ability to break complex problems down into steps that drive operational improvements at Amazon speed. You will bring innovation, a bias for action, and an ability to prioritize and execute on a fast-moving set of strategic priorities. You will be responsible for creating weekly plans, as well as thinking big towards automating existing processes to drive efficiency.
  
  
An ideal candidate should have the ability to pull and analyze data with ease, drive process improvements, standardize existing processes, and eliminate root causes of defects within current systems, with a proven track record of reducing the occurrence of problems through proactive root-cause elimination.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Understand forecasting, demand planning, supply planning, and drive overall operational readiness to meet cost and service targets.
* Champion automation — identify manual processes and drive automated, scalable solutions to improve supply planning, and operational efficiency.
* Work across internal, cross functional partner teams as well as external stakeholders/customers at the project/program level and are able to hold leadership discussions, with limited guidance.
* Have a good understanding of efficiency concepts, programmatic approaches, and tools utilized in supply chain modelling.
* Timely and accurate delivery of headcount plans for respective ROC operations programs considering factors of forecast and operational productivity inputs like AHT, NPT etc. for each site.
* Identify need of different data reporting mechanisms and collaborating with analytics and tech teams and work with stakeholder teams to deep dive and analyze trends across different programs to minimize defects.
* Impact organizational strategy that can be both short or long terms goals such as OP1/OP2.
* Manage the analysis of daily, weekly, and monthly reporting of key planning performance indicators.

**About The Team**
About ROC (Relay Operations Center)
  
  
The Relay Operations Center (ROC) is Amazon's central command and control center for Transportation Execution across the Amazon Supply Chain network. Supporting multiple geographies including North America (NA), Europe (EU), and India (IN), ROC ensures hassle-free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers and from fulfillment centers to carrier hubs.
  
  
In case of any exceptions during the transportation lifecycle, ROC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all stakeholders informed. Beyond tactical problem-solving, ROC is charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
  
  
Overall, ROC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon's transportation network and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon's ability to serve its customers on time.
  
  
**About ROC WFM**
The Workforce Management (WFM) team within ROC is responsible for ensuring the right people are in the right place at the right time to support 24/7 transportation operations. The WFM function encompasses:
  
  

* Volume forecasting and demand planning across all ROC operational sites
* Long-term and short-term capacity planning and resource allocation
* Real-Time Monitoring (RTM) of staffing levels, adherence, and service levels
* Scheduling optimization and shift management across geographies
* Driving automation and AI-powered solutions to enhance planning accuracy and operational efficiency

The WFM team partners closely with Operations, Tech, ACES, Finance, PXT, and Product teams to deliver scalable workforce solutions that support ROC's mission of flawless transportation execution.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
* 2+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience with SQL

* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience partnering with executive-level leaders to identifying and solving business issues

jobs.title: Front-End Engineer II
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

READY TO DO SOMETHING BIG?  
  
How would you build the next generation of experiences that help hundreds of thousands of sellers make smarter decisions about where, when, and how to send billions of products into Amazon’s fulfillment network?  
  
Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is a global service that gives sellers access to Amazon’s world-class fulfillment and distribution network. Sellers—from large global brands to small businesses and entrepreneurs across 135 countries—rely on FBA to store their inventory, fulfill customer orders, and deliver products quickly and reliably to customers around the world.  
  
The FBA Placement organization is at the heart of this experience. We build intelligent systems and seller-facing experiences that determine how inventory enters and is distributed across Amazon’s fulfillment network. Our products help sellers understand their inbound options and make decisions across cost, delivery speed, inventory placement, capacity, and operational constraints—while helping Amazon position inventory closer to customers.  
  
We are looking for a Front-End Engineer II to help build the next generation of FBA inbound and placement experiences.  
  
As a Front-End Engineer II, you will work at the intersection of customer experience and large-scale distributed systems. You will translate complex supply-chain decisions and optimization capabilities into simple, intuitive experiences that sellers can understand and act on. You will build responsive, performant, accessible, and maintainable web applications used by sellers around the world.  
  
You will collaborate closely with UX designers, product managers, software engineers, and science teams to take ideas from concept through launch. You will influence front-end architecture, establish reusable patterns and components, and raise the engineering bar for seller experiences across FBA.  
  
This is an opportunity to solve challenging customer and technical problems, influence the evolution of a global product, and build experiences that directly affect how billions of units move through Amazon’s fulfillment network.  
  
Come join us and help build the future of FBA.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Front-End Engineer II, you will:  
  

* Design, develop, test, and launch high-quality web experiences for FBA sellers worldwide.

  

* Translate complex workflows involving inventory placement, capacity, cost, and delivery options into simple and intuitive customer experiences.

  

* Work closely with UX designers and product managers to turn customer needs and product concepts into scalable technical solutions.

  

* Own significant front-end features and components from design through implementation, launch, measurement, and continuous improvement.

  

* Build reusable UI components, frameworks, and patterns that improve consistency and accelerate development across FBA experiences.

  

* Make sound architectural and technology decisions for large-scale front-end applications while balancing near-term delivery with long-term maintainability.

  

* Integrate front-end experiences with APIs and distributed backend services, designing gracefully for latency, failures, asynchronous operations, and changing data.

  

* Deliver responsive, performant, secure, and accessible experiences across browsers, devices, marketplaces, and seller workflows.

  

* Apply strong computer science and software engineering fundamentals to write simple, extensible, testable, and maintainable code.

  

* Improve engineering quality through code reviews, automated testing, observability, operational excellence, and continuous improvements to development practices.

  

* Investigate customer and operational issues across the full application stack and drive them to resolution.

  

* Collaborate with engineers across FBA and Amazon to influence technical direction and deliver experiences spanning multiple systems and organizations.

  

* Mentor other engineers, contribute to engineering best practices, and help raise the technical bar of the team.

  
A day in the life  
You might start your day reviewing customer feedback and operational metrics for a recently launched seller experience. You could then work with a UX designer and product manager to refine a new workflow that helps sellers understand their inventory placement and delivery options.  
  
Later, you may collaborate with backend and science engineers to define an API contract for a new optimization capability, review a teammate’s design or code change, and spend focused development time building and testing a new experience.  
  
The problems we solve often span UX, front-end architecture, distributed services, and complex supply-chain decisions. You will have significant ownership over how those capabilities ultimately come together as a simple experience for our sellers.  
  
About the team  
The FBA Placement organization owns the technology that determines where and when seller inventory enters Amazon’s fulfillment network.  
  
Our systems evaluate factors including fulfillment cost, customer delivery speed, available capacity, seller preferences, and network constraints to provide sellers with inbound options and recommendations. These decisions have significant impact on both the seller experience and Amazon’s fulfillment network.  
  
Our front-end experiences are where these sophisticated optimization systems become tangible for sellers. Our goal is to make complex supply-chain decisions understandable and actionable—helping sellers confidently choose the right inbound options without needing to understand the complexity of the systems operating behind them.

jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to own the vision, strategy and execution of the roadmap for SmartSense CRE, Ecolibrium's commercial real estate product line within the broader SmartSense platform. The role will work closely with Engineering, Design, Field Operations, Sales and Delivery to turn market insight and customer feedback into products that are competitive, high-quality and aligned to Ecolibrium's business goals.

The Senior Product Manager will lead market research, define product strategy, guide development from concept to launch and track performance against clear KPIs. SmartSense is a technically layered product spanning real-time IoT telemetry, deterministic rules engines, machine learning models and, in select modules, conversational AI. This role requires strong strategic thinking, genuine technical fluency across these layers, stakeholder management and the ability to inspire and align teams around a shared product vision. Requires 7+ years of relevant experience.

**THE WORK**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement product vision, strategy and roadmap for SmartSense CRE, in alignment with Ecolibrium's business goals.
* Conduct thorough market research and competitive analysis, including in AI-enabled energy and building management tooling, to identify trends, opportunities and customer needs.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Design and other teams to guide product development from concept through to launch, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
* Define product requirements for AI-driven features (ML forecasting models, conversational AI modules) with the same rigour as deterministic features, including clear scoping of what the AI is and is not responsible for.
* Engage internal and external stakeholders, including customers, to gather feedback, understand requirements and ensure product success.
* Define and monitor key product performance indicators (KPIs) to measure success and inform product decisions.
* Drive continuous product improvement through customer feedback, data analysis and industry best practices.
* Foster a collaborative environment and work closely with cross-functional teams to achieve product goals.
* Translate market insights and customer needs into actionable product requirements and prioritised backlogs.
* Partner with Sales and Presales to support go-to-market activities, positioning and customer-facing product narratives, ensuring AI capabilities are represented accurately and never overstated.
* Lead and motivate cross-functional teams, setting a compelling product vision that inspires others to deliver against it.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
* 7+ years of experience in product management, with a proven track record of leading successful product initiatives.
* Experience in IoT, building management systems or related industries is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of product development processes, market research techniques and data analysis tools.
* Working fluency with AI product concepts: able to distinguish deterministic rule-based logic from machine learning and from LLM-based conversational features, and to make sound product decisions about where each is appropriate.
* Proven ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Ability to think strategically and translate market insights into actionable product strategies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical and AI-related concepts to diverse, including non-technical, stakeholders.
* Strong customer orientation with a passion for creating products that deliver exceptional value and user experience.

**Desirable**

* Experience as a visionary, analytical and collaborative product leader who thrives on solving complex problems.
* Exposure to energy management, industrial IoT or connected-building product categories.
* Direct experience shipping AI or ML-powered features, including forecasting models, anomaly detection or conversational/LLM-based assistants, and communicating their capabilities and limits honestly to clients.
* Familiarity with agile product development and data-driven experimentation.
* Awareness of responsible AI practices relevant to enterprise B2B products, such as per-tenant data isolation, model risk considerations and honest disclosure of AI capability and certification status.

Want to be part of our story? Apply today!
  
  
**Senior Product Manager, Search, Indexing and Query**
Couchbase | Product Organisation | Bangalore, India | Reports to VP of AI Product Management
  
  
**About The Role**
Couchbase is building the operational data platform for AI. Search, indexing and query are the core of it — how data is found, filtered, ranked and returned is what determines whether an application, or an agent, can actually use the data underneath. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own that surface area across Capella and Couchbase Enterprise: the SQL++ query experience, secondary indexing, full-text search, and vector and hybrid search.
  
  
This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to do the work at the Senior level — write the PRFAQ, sit with the customer, push the tradeoff, ship the capability, and own the outcome after launch. Reporting to the VP of AI Product Management, you will partner closely with the query, indexing and search engineering teams, with sales and GTM, and with the broader AI organization.
  
  
You do not need to have shipped a query engine or a search product before. We are hiring for the underlying capability, not the resume line — see “Who This Role Is Open To” below.
  
  
**What You Will Own**
Search, indexing and query as a product surface: End-to-end ownership of how customers express and satisfy a query on Couchbase — SQL++ query, global secondary indexes, full-text search, and vector and hybrid search. The roadmap in your area, the PRFAQs and PRDs, the launch, the adoption, and the iteration after launch.
  
  
Retrieval for AI applications: Make Couchbase the retrieval layer that RAG applications and agents actually use — hybrid search relevance, metadata filtering, recall and freshness, and cost per query. Work with the wider AI portfolio so retrieval composes with the rest of the platform rather than sitting beside it.
  
  
Developer experience for query and indexing: How a developer writes a query, gets an index recommendation, debugs a slow plan, and understands what a query costs. Reduce the number of things a developer has to know before their first query is fast.
  
  
Performance, cost and benchmark credibility: Own the performance story for your area. Reproducible benchmarks the field can stand behind, a defensible cost and TCO narrative against MongoDB, Elastic, Postgres and pgvector, and dedicated vector stores, and a clear point of view on where Couchbase wins and where it does not.
  
  
Working backwards from the customer: Start with the customer and work backwards. Write the PRFAQ before any code is written. Validate with real, named enterprise customers. Make clear tradeoff calls about what to build and what to defer based on what the enterprise ICP universally needs — not features chasing competitors or one-off requests outside the ICP.
  
  
Engineering partnership: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the query, indexing and search engineering teams. Earn their trust by being technically credible, decisive on scope, and clear on the why. Own the PRD as a living document, not a one-time artifact. Hold the bar on quality, scope, and timing through to launch.
  
  
Customer and design partner engagement: Run design partner programs for the capabilities you own. Bring real customer voice into roadmap decisions and back to the broader team. Help build a pipeline of named reference customers willing to talk publicly about what they have shipped.
  
  
Cross-portfolio collaboration: Coordinate across Core Database, Capella, Analytics, Mobile and Edge, and the AI Specialist team so the capabilities you own compose cleanly with the rest of the platform. Bring a build-vs-partner point of view to your area.
  
  
Sales and GTM partnership: Equip sales, sales engineering, PMM, and partner GTM with what they need to win on search, indexing and query — positioning, demos, competitive context, benchmark data, customer proof points. Be the product owner in deals where the technical depth matters.
  
  
External voice: Contribute as the product owner in customer briefings, webinars, blog posts, documentation, and enablement content for the capabilities you own. Support analyst engagements and keynote content led by the Principal PM, PMM, and AR.

**About The Job**
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
  
  
Hundreds of millions of users consume Memories to look back at their photos library, to ground themselves in what matters most to them.
  
  
While the underlying human need around identity and have not changed, AI is unleashing a set of capabilities that lets us deliver on these needs better than ever before, and in a more personalized way than ever before.
  
  
In this role, your role is to capture this opportunity to deliver the next generation of the Memories experience. You will build a system that understands what's in each user's library and the context of what's going on in their life, and adapts to deliver the right moments at the right time, in formats that are fresh and engaging for that user.
  
  
Google Photos is a photo sharing and storage service developed by Google. Photos is one of the most sought after products at Google and is looking for both client-side (web and mobile), with server-side (search, storage, serving) and machine intelligence (learning, computer vision) Software Engineers. **Company Description**

Honda Motor Co., Ltd., Japan has established a new Digital Innovation entity in India to accelerate growth through customer intelligence, digital platforms, connected experiences, and next-generation mobility solutions.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, this organization will combine Honda’s global scale with India’s technology ecosystem to build capabilities that directly influence product strategy, customer growth, and new business creation across India and other high-growth markets.

We are looking for a Product Manager – Digital Platforms to own the strategy and hands-on execution of customer-facing digital products across mobile apps, web platforms, and future connected services.You will own the roadmap and day-to-day backlog for products that improve ownership experience, service engagement, customer retention, and lifecycle value, working directly with UX and Engineering through the full product cycle rather than one step removed from delivery. This role requires someone who can translate real customer needs and Honda business operations into practical, high-impact digital solutions, and who is equally comfortable in a stakeholder review and a sprint planning session. You will work at the intersection of product, customer experience, engineering, and business growth.

* Experience running structured A/B tests or pilot rollouts
* Field experience in sales, service, dealer network, or customer operations is highly valued

**Why join**

* Own digital products with direct customer and business impact
* Build platforms serving millions of users

jobs.title: Product Manager - I
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Product Manager - I**
**Location: Bangalore**
**Experience: 3 to 5 yrs**
**About Mojro**
Mojro is a logistics automation and optimization company that was started in 2016 with a vision of making logistics simple, smart, and sustainable for enterprise customers. In the span of 10 years, we have built a robust portfolio of products backed by our proprietary and industry-leading algorithms and AI/ML techniques which helps our customers to make complex supply chain decisions, thereby significantly reducing their logistics spend and improving the life of all connected users and customers.
  
  
Our products are trusted by major brands like Unilever, Procter & Gamble, Godrej, Lactalis, and many more. We embrace cutting-edge technologies and encourage innovative solutions to solve ever-evolving supply chain challenges.
  
  
Please visit https://mojro.com for more information.
  
  
**The Role**
As PM-I, you will own one or more product areas end to end, from understanding the customer's problem to shipping the solution and measuring whether it worked.
  
  
You'll work closely with engineering, data science/optimization, design, sales and customer success, and with enterprise customers directly.
  
  
This is not a "write tickets and wait" role. You'll be expected to take a working product and help turn it into a product that many customers rely on: the 1 to 100 journey.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Understand the problem deeply. Spend time with logistics planners, dispatchers and supply chain leaders to learn how they actually work, where they struggle and what they'd pay to fix.
* Define what to build and why. Turn customer needs into clear product requirements, user stories and success metrics. Be able to explain why a feature matters, in numbers.
* Own the roadmap for your area. Prioritise ruthlessly between customer requests, product bets and technical work, and defend those choices with data.
* Work hand in hand with engineering and optimization teams. Translate business problems into terms that algorithm and engineering teams can build on, and translate technical trade-offs back for business teams.
* Ship and scale. Take features from idea to launch, then drive adoption across customers in different geographies and industries.
* Measure what matters. Track usage, customer outcomes (cost per delivery, vehicle utilisation, on-time performance) and product health. Use these to decide what to improve next.
* Support the go-to-market. Partner with sales and pre-sales on demos, RFPs and customer conversations; help marketing tell the product story clearly.
* Bring market awareness. Keep a close eye on competitors, industry trends and new technology (especially AI) that could change how logistics planning is done.

**What We're Looking For**
**Must-haves**

* Engineering degree (CSE, ECE, Electronics, Mechanical or related) from a premier institute such as the IITs, NITs or equivalent.
* 3 - 5 years of experience at a product company with a strong product and engineering culture.
* Proven 1- to - 100 experience: you've taken a product or feature that existed and helped grow it, in users, customers, revenue or scale. Be ready to talk about what you did and what changed because of it.
* Comfort with numbers and logic. You can build a simple model in a spreadsheet, read a dashboard and reason through trade-offs.
* Clear communication. You can write a crisp spec and explain a complex idea to a CXO and an engineer on the same day.
* A go-getter attitude. You don't wait to be told. You see a gap, you own it and you close it.

**Good to have**

* MBA from a reputed institute (preferred, not mandatory).
* Supply chain, logistics, transportation or mobility domain experience (preferred, not mandatory)
* Exposure to B2B SaaS / enterprise products and selling to large customers.
* Familiarity with optimization, AI/ML or data-heavy products.

**Why Join Mojro**

* A stable workplace with committed founders, trusted investors, and happy customers.
* A clear mission with a positive impact on the supply chain domain.
* An inclusive, collaborative, and supportive environment with equal opportunities and recognition.
* Competitive salary packages and comprehensive benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off.
* Open and transparent communication from leadership about company goals, challenges, and updates.
* A family of Mojroians with whom we celebrate events throughout the year.

India

Product Management

Sr. Director, Cloud Platform
  
  
**Are you...**

* Interested in shaping shared cloud platform services that power multiple products and engineering teams?
* Passionate about platform product management, developer experience, and turning complex technical capabilities into valuable products?
* Excited to work alongside Architects and Engineering leaders to shape the evolution of a modern cloud and AI platform?

If so, we'd love to meet you.
  
  
**Why Esko?**
Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25,000 customers across 140+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation.
  
  
Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence.

We are looking for a
**Senior Product Manager – Cloud Platform Services**
to define and drive the product strategy for the cloud platform services that power Esko's SaaS products.
  
  
You will own the product direction and roadmap for foundational capabilities such as repository and data services, workflow, search, APIs, and other shared platform services used across multiple Esko products. You will work closely with Architects, Engineering leaders, and Product Managers to identify common platform needs, establish priorities, drive adoption, and translate platform strategy into an executable roadmap.

* Partner with product and engineering teams to identify common needs and opportunities for reusable platform capabilities.

* Drive a strong developer experience, making platform capabilities easier to discover, integrate, and adopt.
* Lead cross-platform planning and align dependencies across Platform Services, IAM, Infrastructure Engineering, and consuming product teams.
* Balance product needs, platform investments, technical debt, reliability, scalability, and architectural evolution when setting priorities.
* Define success measures and use adoption, usage, developer experience, reliability, and business outcomes to guide platform investments.

**Required Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in the software industry, including 5+ years in product management for cloud, SaaS, API, developer, or other technically complex software products.
* Experience owning the strategy and roadmap for platform products or shared services used by multiple products or engineering teams.
* Strong technical understanding of APIs, microservices, distributed systems, data stores, multi-tenancy, and cloud-native architectures.
* Demonstrated ability to participate effectively in architecture and technical design discussions with Architects and senior Engineers, understand trade-offs, and connect technical decisions to product outcomes.
* Experience with APIs and developer-facing products, including concepts such as API contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, integration patterns, and developer experience.
* Strong product judgment and ability to prioritize across product capabilities, technical investments, reliability, scalability, and developer experience.
* Experience defining and using adoption, usage, and outcome metrics to guide product decisions.
* Strong communication and influencing skills, with experience driving alignment across Product, Architecture, and Engineering teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Prior experience in software engineering, solution architecture, technical product management, or another hands-on technical role.
* Experience with developer platforms, API platforms, or shared cloud services.
* Experience with platform capabilities such as workflow, search, repository/data services, APIs, or integration services.
* Experience in a multi-product SaaS organization where shared platform capabilities serve multiple products.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Cloud Platform Services have a clear strategy, roadmap, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
* Product teams understand what the platform provides, how to consume it, and where ownership boundaries lie.
* Shared platform capabilities evolve based on common product needs, adoption, and long-term platform strategy.
* Platform capabilities become easier to discover, integrate, and adopt, reducing developer friction and duplicated engineering effort.
* You become a trusted product leader known for strong product judgment, technical credibility, and the ability to align Product, Architecture, and Engineering.

We are hiring a Sr. Data Product Manager to own a portfolio of Target Media data products end-to-end — from business definitions and contracts through datasets, pipelines, quality, governance, and delivery.
  
  
This is a hands-on role that works closely with Data Engineering, Analytics and Media Partners. You will partner with DE day-to-day to build and evolve datasets and pipelines across a medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture, shape schemas and contracts, and make sure the data products that result are trusted and well-governed. The core job is to translate technical capability into business outcomes. You will sit at the intersection of Roundel product, Data Engineering, MediaOps, and the broader Media Data Consumers.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**
We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager — Measurement & Analytics to lead the strategy, development, and evolution of data products that enable marketing measurement and attribution across Target Media.
  
  
**Measurement – Must Have**
This role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing Measurement, Analytics and Data Engineering. You will own products that help the organization understand the impact of marketing investments across channels, campaigns, audiences, and customer journeys.
  
  
The initial focus will be on Roundel and Target marketing spend, with the opportunity to expand measurement capabilities across loyalty, promotions, and other enterprise marketing investments.
  
  
A core responsibility will be building and scaling attribution and measurement capabilities that connect marketing exposure and spend to business outcomes, enabling stakeholders to understand what worked, why it worked, and where to invest next.
  
  
Analytics & Data Fluency — Must Have
  
  
Strong Working Knowledge Of Analytics And Data Concepts, With The Ability To Partner Effectively With Analytics Teams. You Should Be Comfortable With
  
  

* Customer-level and aggregated analytics
* Data aggregation and dimensional modelling
* Data pipelines and data transformations
* Data quality and reconciliation
* Metric definitions and semantic layers

Building data products with Data Engineering
  
  
You work hand-in-hand with Data Engineering to turn requirements into real datasets and pipelines — translating business needs into clear specs, prioritizing the backlog, and making trade-off calls with DE on design and sequencing.
  
  
Platform & ecosystem stewardship
  
  
Solid understand of Data Platform, cloud environment of GCP/BQ/PowerBI
  
  
Trust, governance & data quality — critical
  
  
Data governance and data quality are central to this role, not an afterthought. As operational systems and automated workflows act on Roundel data, the cost of a stale or wrong data product rises sharply.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years in product management, with meaningful time across Measurement, data products, data platforms, AdTech/MarTech, or retail media.

* Track record of translating technical capability into measurable business outcomes and influencing cross-functional partners without direct authority.
* Strong understand if PM Practices and working with Data Engineering, Analysts and Stakeholders.

You will partner with DE day-to-day to build and evolve datasets and pipelines across a medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture, shape schemas and contracts, and make sure the data products that result are trusted and well-governed. The core job is to translate technical capability into business outcomes. You will sit at the intersection of Roundel product, Data Engineering, MediaOps, and the broader Media Data Consumers.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**
We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager — Measurement & Analytics to lead the strategy, development, and evolution of data products that enable marketing measurement and attribution across Target Media.
  
  
**Measurement – Must Have**
This role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing Measurement, Analytics and Data Engineering. You will own products that help the organization understand the impact of marketing investments across channels, campaigns, audiences, and customer journeys.
  
  
The initial focus will be on Roundel and Target marketing spend, with the opportunity to expand measurement capabilities across loyalty, promotions, and other enterprise marketing investments.
  
  
A core responsibility will be building and scaling attribution and measurement capabilities that connect marketing exposure and spend to business outcomes, enabling stakeholders to understand what worked, why it worked, and where to invest next.
  
  
Analytics & Data Fluency — Must Have
  
  
Strong Working Knowledge Of Analytics And Data Concepts, With The Ability To Partner Effectively With Analytics Teams. You Should Be Comfortable With
  
  

* Customer-level and aggregated analytics
* Data aggregation and dimensional modelling
* Data pipelines and data transformations
* Data quality and reconciliation
* Metric definitions and semantic layers

Building data products with Data Engineering
  
  
You work hand-in-hand with Data Engineering to turn requirements into real datasets and pipelines — translating business needs into clear specs, prioritizing the backlog, and making trade-off calls with DE on design and sequencing.
  
  
Platform & ecosystem stewardship
  
  
Solid understand of Data Platform, cloud environment of GCP/BQ/PowerBI
  
  
Trust, governance & data quality — critical
  
  
Data governance and data quality are central to this role, not an afterthought. As operational systems and automated workflows act on Roundel data, the cost of a stale or wrong data product rises sharply.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years in product management, with meaningful time across Measurement, data products, data platforms, AdTech/MarTech, or retail media.
* Proven understanding Marketing Measurement concepts of Attribution, MTA, MMM, etc.
* Hands-on experience working closely with Data Engineering to build datasets and pipelines — writing specs, shaping schemas and contracts, and prioritizing a technical backlog.
* Solid understanding of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and modern data platforms (Lakehouse, data mesh, or federated architectures), including lineage and cost.
* Strong grasp of data governance and data quality — certification, monitoring, access, and consent — treated as critical, not optional.
* Track record of translating technical capability into measurable business outcomes and influencing cross-functional partners without direct authority.
* Strong understand if PM Practices and working with Data Engineering, Analysts and Stakeholders.

The Tech Development Lead is a Grade 8 individual contributor who supports design, build, deployment, and operates reliable data pipelines and AI-enabled solutions. The role applies to technical judgment across data engineering, GenAI, and agent engineering, with accountability for production reliability, observability, trusted data access, prompt effectiveness, and responsible operation in a regulated environment.

  
  

The role owns complex components of the data and AI landscape end-to-end, makes day-to-day technical decisions with limited oversight, and helps shape practical engineering direction. * Establish agent reliability, observability, guardrails, and escalation controls for stable and compliant production operation.
* Use AI-assisted engineering as a core working practice while applying strong judgment to generated code, tests, documentation, recommendations, and downstream risk implications.
  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**1. Data Pipeline & Platform Engineering**

* Independently design, build, deploy, and operate batch and streaming data pipelines that meet defined expectations for freshness, correctness, reliability, performance, and cost.

* Act as an effective first-line tester for changes and enhancements, with clear evidence of validation and traceability.
* Influence architecture and tooling decisions, balancing delivery speed with maintainability, supportability, scalability, and compliance.

* Support month-end close, forecasting, planning and outlook processes.

* Ensure exceptional accuracy, completeness and timeliness across all deliverables.

* Convert large datasets into clear and concise performance views.

* Support the rationalization and automation of existing reports.

* Help transition manual reporting processes toward scalable and repeatable solutions.

* Support development of self-service reporting tools where appropriate.
  

  

**Data and Technical Capability**

* Work with large and unfamiliar financial and operational datasets.

* Navigate data lakes, tables, columns, hierarchies and business definitions with support from senior team members.

* Use SQL to extract, combine, validate and analyze data.

* Use Python for data manipulation, automation and analytical tasks.

* Perform data collection, cleansing, validation and reconciliation across multiple sources.

* Identify inconsistencies or potential data-quality issues and escalate them appropriately.

* Build and maintain structured datasets for recurring analysis and reporting.

* Use Excel extensively for financial analysis and modeling.

**ZEISS in India**

ZEISS in India is headquartered in Bengaluru and present in the fields of Industrial Quality Solutions, Research Microscopy Solutions, Medical Technology, Vision Care and Sports & Cine Optics.

ZEISS India has 3 production facilities, R&D center, Global IT services and about 40 Sales & Service offices in almost all Tier I and Tier II cities in India. With 2200+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS’ success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace.

Further information at ZEISS India .

***Job Purpose***

**Welcome to ZEISS – a company that combines innovation and responsibility!**  
You will play an important role in contributing to the success of digital transformation at ZEISS, with a vision of bringing people, processes, and data together, reliably and easily, to enable all ZEISS employees to work efficiently on one platform. The ServiceNow Team is responsible for operating and customizing/developing Enterprise Service Management and custom applications on the ServiceNow platform.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced **ServiceNow ITSM Technology Lead** who can work closely on ITSM Development and Architecture requirements and design, develop, implement, and continuously improve enterprise IT Service Management solutions on the ServiceNow platform.

The role combines **solution architecture, hands-on development, technical leadership, and ITSM process expertise** . The ideal candidate will work closely with Product Owners, Process Owners, business stakeholders, architects, and development teams to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable ServiceNow solutions aligned with the organization's IT strategy.

***Key Responsibilities***

***Architecture & Solution Design***

* Define end-to-end ServiceNow ITSM solution architecture and technical design.
* Translate business and ITSM requirements into scalable ServiceNow solutions.
* Establish technical standards, development guidelines, and architectural patterns.
* Ensure solutions align with ServiceNow best practices, platform capabilities, and enterprise architecture.
* Participate in architecture and design reviews.
* Identify opportunities to reduce customization and improve platform maintainability.
* Support integration architecture across ServiceNow and enterprise applications ***.***

***ITSM Development***

* Develop and maintain business rules, client scripts, UI policies, UI actions, Script Includes, Flow Designer workflows, notifications, and integrations.
* Develop reusable components and automation to improve operational efficiency.
* Perform code reviews and ensure development follows platform standards.
* Troubleshoot complex technical and production issues.
* Design and implement integrations between ServiceNow and external systems.
* Work with REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server, and other integration technologies.

**Technical Leadership**

* Provide technical leadership to ServiceNow developers and implementation teams.
* Mentor developers and conduct technical knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Review technical designs, code, and implementation approaches.
* Support estimation, planning, sprint execution, and release activities.
* Act as the technical point of contact for ITSM initiatives.

**Platform Governance**

* Ensure adherence to ServiceNow upgrade-safe development practices.
* Minimize unnecessary customizations.
* Establish standards for scripting, workflows, integrations, security, and performance.
* Support ServiceNow upgrades, releases, health checks, and technical debt reduction.
* Monitor platform performance and proactively identify technical risks.

***Education & Work Experience***

* Completed degree in computer science, business informatics, engineering, or a comparable qualification.
* Extensive professional experience as a ServiceNow Solution Architect, Application Specialist in a global enterprise environment.
* Proven experience in designing, implementing, and operating ServiceNow solutions, ideally including AI-enabled capabilities.
* Strong experience in ServiceNow implementation projects, stakeholder management, and integration of external systems.
* Experience in agile or hybrid delivery models, with strong teamwork, ownership, and result orientation.
* ServiceNow development or full-stack development knowledge is advantageous.

**Required Skills & Expertise**

* **7+ years of ServiceNow experience** , preferably with significant ITSM implementation experience.
* Strong experience in ServiceNow architecture and hands-on development.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL and ITSM processes.
* Experience with integrations, APIs, enterprise data sources, knowledge management.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, maintainable, and standard-oriented ServiceNow solutions.
* Strong communication, consulting, analytical thinking, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – ITSM
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
* ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) — desirable for senior architecture roles
* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher
* Relevant CSDM/CMDB certifications or training
