* Mentor Platform teams in the optimal usage of IaC, CaC, and GitOps within the scope of the landing zones.
* Work closely with DevOps, development teams and suppliers to secure that the value planned will be delivered in the most optimal way.

**What We’re Looking For:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, system analysis or a related study, or equivalent experience.
* Demonstrable 8 + years of experience working with multiple Cloud Providers. Extensive experience with Azure?AWS/GCP is mandatory.
* Proficiency in hands-on IaC development. Extensive experience utilizing Terraform is a must.

**In this role, a typical day will look like:**

**Role: Master Data Management Lead**

**Location: Bangalore**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Master Data Operations**

* Create, modify, block and deactivate master data in Oracle Fusion and other designated systems in accordance with approved requests and established governance.
* Maintain master data across key domains including Customer, Product/Item, Supplier and Finance master data, based on defined role responsibilities.
* Validate that requests contain required approvals and supporting information before execution.
* Ensure master-data changes are accurately reflected in applicable downstream systems and integrations.
* Manage requests within defined service-level agreements and business priorities.

**Data Quality & Governance**

* Perform regular data-quality checks for completeness, accuracy, consistency and duplicates.

* Maintain appropriate documentation and audit trails for master-data changes.

**Controls & Compliance**

* Execute master-data activities in accordance with Esko's internal control and SOX requirements.
* Maintain appropriate segregation between request, approval and execution of master-data changes.
* Support internal and external audit requests relating to master-data controls.
* Escalate unauthorized, incomplete or non-compliant requests.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Track MDM operational KPIs including request volumes, turnaround time, first-time-right rate, backlog, data-quality exceptions and SLA performance.
* Identify opportunities to standardize and automate master-data processes.
* Support simplification of master-data structures and workflows following Project LEAP.
* Participate in root-cause analysis of defects and operational issues resulting from master-data quality.

**Business Partnership**

* Work closely with global Data Owners and Data Stewards across Finance, Product Management, Commercial Operations, Procurement, Service and IT.
* Provide guidance to users on master-data requirements and processes.
* Support ongoing Oracle Fusion stabilization and future system/business integrations.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems or related discipline.
* **7–10 years' experience**, ideally someone who has helped establish MDM in an Oracle/shared-services environment; experience in master data, finance operations, shared services, ERP operations or a related function.
* Experience with Oracle Fusion strongly preferred; experience with another major ERP platform also relevant.
* Experience with PowerBI, SQL
* Understanding of customer, supplier, product/item and/or financial master data.
* Experience working within a controlled/SOX environment preferred.

jobs.title: Product Owner III
jobs.description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.

  

By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications.  We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.

**Role Overview:**
  

PDI Technologies is looking for a Product Owner to help drive our mobile product roadmap from vision to delivery. This individual will take roadmap initiatives and solution briefs and break them down into clear, well-structured PRDs that our engineering teams can pick up and execute against — keeping delivery moving in a fast-paced, iterative environment.

  

This role sits within our broader Mobile Platform and Framework effort — the underlying solution that lets customers bring a highly customizable, flexible branded app to market — with expected primary focus on Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), a web-based portal being built on top of the Mobile Platform that will let end customers modify, update, and change elements of their own mobile app themselves, backed by a full publishing engine. MEM is early in its build, so this is a chance to help shape a new product from the ground up alongside engineering and design. Exact scope of ownership across the Mobile Platform and MEM will be finalized as the team ramps up, and there is flexibility for this to evolve.

  

As a Product Owner, you are a critical member of an Agile development team, translating product strategy into high-quality, high-value features. You'll work closely with Agile engineering teams, Product Managers, customers, and business stakeholders to shape requirements for our consumer-facing mobile experiences. Prior experience in Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analyst roles for a consumer-focused mobile app or platform/framework product is highly desired.

  

This role is expected to use AI tools and processes as a core part of how work gets done — accelerating requirements-gathering, documentation, and story breakdown so the team can move faster without sacrificing quality.

  
**Key Responsibilities:**
  

  
* Stay aligned with and contribute to the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), with visibility into the broader Mobile Platform/Framework
  
* Translate roadmap initiatives and solution briefs into detailed, engineering-ready PRDs and user stories
  
* Help define and evolve requirements for MEM's publishing engine — how customers configure, preview, and push changes to their live mobile app
  
* As needed, extend into Mobile Platform-level decisions (what should be configurable, extensible, or standardized across customers) as they intersect with MEM
  
* Work closely with Support to understand and prioritize customer-reported issues affecting the mobile app and platform experience
  
* Work closely with system users (customers, partners, consulting) to understand product needs and translate them into actionable user stories
  
* Apply technical astuteness, attention to detail, and proactivity to drive closure and optimize development team throughput
  
* Use AI-assisted tools and workflows to speed up requirements analysis, documentation, and backlog preparation
  
* Serve as a product evangelist, particularly with Product Managers and Business teams, helping them understand platform best practices
  
* Develop documentation for new mobile and MEM features, including UI mockups, process flows, and data sequence diagrams
  
* Attend sprint planning meetings and work with the team to define sprint goals
  
* Guide Agile teams in breaking down user stories and defining acceptance criteria
  
* Ensure the product backlog is prioritized and properly balanced between new product work and maintenance
  
* Collaborate with engineering during sprints to review output and answer questions about desired functionality and outcomes
  
* Ensure the team has an appropriately groomed backlog ready for sprint planning; monitor ready stories vs. velocity
  
* Conduct backlog refinement meetings, sprint reviews, and product demos
  
* Manage the product backlog in ALM tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
  
* Author and publish product release notes and customer notifications
  
* Own release planning for Mobile Platform and MEM initiatives
  
  

  
**Qualifications:**
  

  
* Prior experience with consumer-facing mobile apps (iOS/Android) — writing requirements, PRDs, or user stories for a mobile product strongly preferred
  
* Experience with platform, framework, or configurable/multi-tenant products is a strong plus, given the customizable nature of the Mobile Platform
  
* Comfort defining requirements for a 0-to-1 product (like MEM) with evolving scope, including working with design on portal/UI workflows
  
* Ability to break down ambiguous roadmap items and solution briefs into scoped, sequenced, engineering-ready PRDs
  
* Familiarity with mobile-specific considerations (app store release processes, platform guidelines, mobile UX patterns) is a plus
  
* Fluent with — or genuinely eager to learn — AI-assisted product workflows (e.g., using AI tools to accelerate PRD drafting, backlog refinement, research synthesis, and documentation) in order to move quickly in a fast-paced environment
  
* 2–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Manager, Product Owner, or similar role, including at least 2 years working as an Agile Product Owner
  
* Highly motivated self-starter with a desire to help others, take action, and seek out resources to excel within the role
  
* Strong written and verbal communication…

jobs.description:
**Overview**
**Sr. Business Systems Analyst, People & Internal Systems**
HealthEdge is in a period of rapid growth and consolidation following recent mergers. The Business Technology team exists to make sure the systems that power our business keep up — not just running, but evolving alongside the teams that depend on them.
  
  
We're hiring a Sr. Business Systems Analyst to join our Business Technology Team.
  
  
You'll bring deep expertise in enterprise integrations — APIs, middleware, iPaaS. In the near term, you'll have a strong focus on building out and stabilizing integrations as we migrate off legacy systems. This role is designed to grow: more platform ownership, broader systems scope and expanded stakeholder relationships over time.
  
  
If you're a technically sharp integrations specialist who thrives on keeping complex system ecosystems healthy, and wants a role with real ownership from day one — this role is for you.
  
  
**In This Role, You'll Get To**

* Own the integration layer. Share ownership of our active integrations across payroll, benefits, identity management, finance and more — monitoring health, resolving failures, and improving reliability over time.
* Configure and improve. Work across enterprise systems and with business stakeholders, providing input on business processes, condition rules and security to support evolving needs.
* Automate what shouldn't be manual. Identify and eliminate repetitive work through business process automation, calculated fields, iPaaS tooling, and Claude-powered workflows.
* Measure what matters. Connect what you build to outcomes — integration uptime, data quality, Claude adoption and usage, process cycle time. Know whether your solution moved the needle and explain impact in business terms, not just technical ones.
* Be the trusted partner. Embed yourself in how teams actually work, surfacing friction before stakeholders have to tell you about it, translating what you find into requirements, and building the case for what needs to change.
* Think in systems. Design solutions for longevity — upstream and downstream, anticipating what breaks three hops down the road, building for scale rather than just solving today's problem.
* Bring an AI-first lens to the work. Use AI tools, including Claude, to accelerate your own output — analysis, documentation, testing, solution design — and look for opportunities to bring that lens to how the business operates.
* Grow with the team. As HealthEdge scales and the Business Technology team matures, there's real opportunity to expand into broader systems, integrations and AI platform ownership — for the right person who wants to keep growing.
* Build institutional knowledge. Maintain thorough documentation of system configuration, integration architecture, data flows and Claude governance .

**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years in business systems, integrations or IT platform roles — with direct, hands-on experience building and supporting enterprise integrations (APIs, EIB-style tooling, Core Connectors or similar)
* Strong working knowledge of integration patterns — APIs, SFTP, middleware, SSO and how data moves between enterprise systems — and proven ability to troubleshoot when things break in production
* Hands-on experience with automation — business process logic, calculated fields, or iPaaS platforms (MuleSoft, Workato, Boomi or similar) — and a track record of reducing manual work
* Experience partnering with business stakeholders to translate requirements into system configuration — you understand both the technical and functional sides of the platforms you own
* Strong data fluency — you validate, interpret and explain data clearly, and understand how system configuration decisions affect what lands downstream
* Comfort with ambiguity — this team is building its own playbook and you'll help write it; you don't need a perfect brief to get started
* Clear communicator who translates technical complexity for business and non-technical audiences without losing the substance
* Familiarity with data privacy and security frameworks (HIPAA, HITRUST, or similar) as they apply to enterprise data, AI platform usage and cross-system data flows
* AI-first by default: you already reach for AI tools in your daily work, experiment on your own, and are genuinely curious about what comes next — not just willing to use AI when asked

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
  
  
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
  
  
If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of

The role resides within the Data Management Change Team, reporting to the Data Change Lead in Bangalore. The position is for a Data Business Analyst within the Data Analytics Office, focused on supporting operational business teams with requirements that depend on Asset Management Data Services. You will work across multiple data services and operational teams to support data service delivery aligned to stakeholder needs, with an initial focus on Security, Holdings and Environmental, Social and Governance data services and vendor data delivery to performance and reporting, client business, and investment teams.

* Produce high-quality business requirements and functional requirements documentation in line with project expectations and governance.
* Participate in, and where required chair, project and analysis meetings, clearly communicating outcomes, actions, and next steps.
* Define and support testing activities, including planning and executing data testing aligned to requirements and agreed test scenarios.
* Proactively explore brief requirements raised through Jira stories to achieve full clarity, identify gaps, and drive alignment across stakeholders.
* Manage defects for assigned deliveries, including tracking, prioritising, following up on fixes, and coordinating re-testing with relevant teams.
* Communicate confidently and effectively, asking the right questions, challenging constructively when needed, and providing clear responses to stakeholders.
* Work collaboratively with global and regional business and technology teams across time zones, contributing to delivery momentum and shared outcomes.

* Minimum 6 years’ relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline.
* Demonstrable experience in business analysis, including translating business needs into business requirements and functional requirements.

* In-depth knowledge of holdings data, securities data, ESG data services, and ESG data providers.
* Experience working with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
